newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ICI Australia still keen on Asian buys.
newsitem.headline: ICI Australia still keen on Asian buys.

text.p: Chemical and plastics group ICI Australia Ltd said on Wednesday it was close to making one or more acquisitions in Asia, which would cost less than A$50 million.
"There are some that are in a very advanced stage and I am hopeful to be able to do something with those in the next couple of months," managing director Warren Hayne told a news conference.
Haynes said any acquisitions would cost a bit less than A$50 million.

ICI Australia, which is 62.4 percent owned by Imperial Chemicals Industries Plc, earlier reported a net profit of A$110.7 million for the six months to March 31, compared with A$92.6 million in the 1995/96 first half.
